name: PARACETAMOL / CHLORZOXAZONE 300/250MG 30 TABLETS
description: Chlorzoxazone + paracetamol. Paracetamol: analgesic and antipyretic. It inhibits prostaglandin synthesis in the CNS and blocks the generation of pain impulses at the peripheral level. It acts on the hypothalamic temperature-regulating center. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
